items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: Frank Keeling, he played all in band.

ctx.x: And how did he play, did he read good, too, or just the most clear? He could play with anybody, he could play with anybody.
Frank Keeling, he played all in band.
How old would you say he was, or do you know when he died?
